note: Signature abilities (career and the daily challenge; off in ranked and friendly until balance sims are clean). trigger = when it fires, effect = what changes, magnitude = how much (0.1 = 10%), duration in seconds (0 = that shot), cooldown in seconds. Never changes net-fault rules or the net-kill/net-spin thresholds. from_sheet = numbers from the owner's roster sheet.

abilities.name: Counterstrike
abilities.text: A perfectly timed defensive shot goes 5% faster.

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.text: After a successful retrieval, 8% faster movement for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Iron Formation
abilities.text: After a successful block, the opponent’s smashes are 10% slower for 2 seconds (never below the game’s smash floor).

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.text: Below 20 energy, matches use 12% less energy.

abilities.name: False Opening
abilities.text: Drops, net shots and flicks have a 7% better chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Silk Touch
abilities.text: Net shots are 12% more precise.

abilities.name: Net Dominance
abilities.text: After winning a point at the net, the next attacking shot is 10% faster (smashes stay within the game’s limit).

abilities.name: Phantom Rhythm
abilities.text: Changing shot type from your last shot gives a 9% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Early Pressure
abilities.text: Attacking shots taken early (within 0.6 s of the opponent’s shot) are 8% faster.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Guard
abilities.text: After a successful block, the opponent’s next smash is 10% slower (never below the game’s smash floor).

abilities.name: Crosscourt Flick
abilities.text: A crosscourt lift or flick has a 10% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Late Drive
abilities.text: Drives are 8% faster.

abilities.name: Falcon Counter
abilities.text: Returning a smash with a drive or push makes it 12% faster.

abilities.name: Backcourt Clear
abilities.text: Clears are 10% more accurate.

abilities.name: Angle Slice
abilities.text: Drops land 10% closer to where you aim.

abilities.name: Feather Touch
abilities.text: Net shots are 10% more precise.

abilities.name: Net Thread
abilities.text: A 10% wider perfect-timing window on net shots (net rules and tumbling are unchanged).

abilities.name: Phantom Drop
abilities.text: Drops have a 15% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Thunder Rebound
abilities.text: Smashes are up to 8% faster (within the game’s smash limit).

abilities.name: Silent Crossfire
abilities.text: A crosscourt smash or drive has a 12% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Steady Lift
abilities.text: Lifts are 12% more accurate in depth.

abilities.name: Quickfire Smash
abilities.text: Smashes are up to 6% faster (within the game’s smash limit).

abilities.name: Tempest Clear
abilities.text: After a clear, the opponent moves 12% slower for 1.2 seconds.

abilities.name: Vortex Net Trap
abilities.text: Net shots are 15% more precise (net rules and tumbling are unchanged).

abilities.name: Mirage Switch
abilities.text: Any crosscourt shot has a 12% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Burst Return
abilities.text: After a successful retrieval, 10% quicker recovery between swings for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Razor Drop
abilities.text: Drops are 12% more accurate.

abilities.name: Ghostline Drive
abilities.text: Drives are 15% more accurate.

abilities.name: Phantom Cascade
abilities.text: A crosscourt drop has a 15% chance of wrong-footing the opponent.

abilities.name: Halo Tumble
abilities.text: A 15% wider perfect-timing window on net shots (net rules and tumbling are unchanged).
